"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The American people's hard work has led to America's current prosperity, progress, and peace.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The 2000 election will be about the big choices America has to make to secure prosperity that is broadly shared and progress that reaches all families in this new American century.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In the year 2000, the Democratic Party stands ready to meet the challenge of securing broadly shared prosperity and progress and to build on its achievements.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In 1800, America was a young country trying to find its place in the world.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats gather at a moment of vast possibility to nominate Al Gore as America's next president.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A new economy founded on the force of new technologies and traditional values of work is giving rise to new industries and transforming old ones.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Biological breakthroughs give the chance to unlock the mysteries of humanity's deadliest plagues.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"More people live under governments of freedom, liberty, and democracy than ever before in history.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"America enjoys unparalleled affluence at home and influence abroad.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
